flagged.statement: The Board has 14 directors: all 14 director nominees for election at the 2023 annual meeting are current Board members, each serving until the next annual meeting.
At the 2022 annual meeting the Board had 14 then-current members, all of whom attended.
64% of the 14 director nominees, nine nominees, are independent.
11 directors will constitute the Board immediately following the 2022 annual meeting.

Sitting directors nominated for re-election: Quincy L. Allen, Martha Helena Bejar, Peter C. Brown, Kevin P. Chilton, Steven T. “Terry” Clontz, T. Michael Glenn, W. Bruce Hanks, Hal Stanley Jones, Michael Roberts, Laurie Siegel and Jeffrey K. Storey.
Hal Stanley Jones was added to (joined) the Board effective January 1, 2020.
The Board has 12 members; all twelve are standing for re-election as the 2023 Director nominees, each to serve until the next Annual Meeting.

The Board determined that all current Directors other than Dr. Albert Bourla are independent: 11 independent Directors, namely Susan Desmond-Hellmann, Scott Gottlieb, Helen H. Hobbs, Susan Hockfield, Dan R. Littman, Suzanne Nora Johnson, Ronald E. Blaylock, Joseph J. Echevarria, Shantanu Narayen, James Quincey and James C. Smith; the determination relied on the Governance & Sustainability Committee report, including a review finding director-affiliated transactions below the Standards thresholds.
